title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Shipping Fees and Delivery Terms
content:
Shipping fees and the delivery terms that govern lost, damaged, not-received and defective packages of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, by tier.

## Fees

| Tier | Standard ground shipping fee | Free-shipping threshold (shipment cash-price total) | Expedited (two-day) shipping fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 6.95 USD | 75.00 USD | 24.50 USD |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 24.50 USD |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 24.50 USD |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 24.50 USD |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 24.50 USD |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 24.50 USD |

The standard fee applies to a refill below the free-shipping threshold; a threshold of 0.00 means standard shipping is always free. The expedited fee is for customer-requested expedited shipping and is never billed to a payer.

## Delivery terms

| Tier | Carrier trace period (business days after the expected delivery date) | Courtesy reships per rolling 12 months | Damage report window (calendar days from delivery) | Defect report window (calendar days from delivery) | Signature on receiver delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | No |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | No |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | No |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | Yes |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | Yes |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 3 | 1 | 7 | 30 | Yes |

- **Carrier trace period**: business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit.
- **Courtesy reships**: the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- **Damage report window**: the window for reporting a package damaged in transit, counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Defect report window**: the window for reporting an item defective as shipped (wrong model, expired or short-dated, recalled lot), counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Signature on receiver delivery**: whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of a receiver (E2103) package; sensor packages are delivered on carrier scan.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical self-pay shipment priced at 74.99 USD is below the 75.00 USD threshold and carries the 6.95 USD standard fee; a shipment priced at exactly 75.00 USD reaches the threshold and ships free.
